tweetText: Big AI companies are gearing up to go public, which could lead to rising prices across the sector. This shift may reshape the market and attract more investment in AI technology. via TechCrunch AI

Notion has restored access to Anthropic after a service disruption that surprised many users. This matters because it highlights the strong demand for AI tools and the impact of outages on productivity. via TechCrunch AI

OpenAI is developing a "super app," signaling a shift away from chat as the main focus. This could redefine how we interact with AI, expanding its applications beyond simple conversations. via TechCrunch AI

AI content creators are becoming harder to distinguish from real people, making them more influential in social media. This shift raises concerns about authenticity and trust in online interactions. via The Verge AI
